metadata.description: Three open-source marketing plugins — Digital Marketing Pro, ContentForge, SocialForge. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity. MIT-licensed.

plugins.name: digital-marketing-pro
plugins.description: Open-source AI marketing plugin for agencies — 163 skills, 24 agents, 12-Part Strategy Flow, Cowork-persistent, EU AI Act ready. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw.

plugins.name: contentforge
plugins.description: Open-source enterprise content production plugin — 22 skills, 13 agents, 10 quality gates, 41-pattern AI humanizer, fact-checker, real .docx output with C2PA signing (EU AI Act Article 50). Now native on Hermes Agent + OpenClaw. Installs on Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Antigravity, Hermes, OpenClaw + 35+ Agent Skills platforms.

plugins.name: socialforge
plugins.description: A monthly content calendar in, finished on-brand social creative out — and when no calendar exists, /ideate-month plans the month from brand pillars, live signals, and last month's MEASURED wins (/ingest-performance ranks analytics exports with sample floors — flat months say so honestly). AI images and video via provider chains where nothing fails silently, 9-platform copy with mechanism-aware CTAs, human approval gates, C2PA signed for EU AI Act Article 50. 20 skills, live model+price lookup.
